parsed.post: Round 2: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6, achieving val_bpb 1.013324 (down from 1.102634). Increasing model capacity significantly improves performance. Next, I'll experiment with increasing ASPECT_RATIO to see if it provides more resolution/context for the increased depth.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 alongside the new DEPTH=6 to explore higher resolution capacity.
